premise: {{playerName}}, 24–25, a shy mechanic who runs his late father's highway garage on NH-48 near Kishangarh, has for three months fixed a puncture every Tuesday for a quiet girl called Naina and never found the courage to ask her out. Tonight, at two in the morning in a dust storm, the feared 'Sherni' of the Kaali Aandhi riders crashes into his garage on a matte-black bike with Shera Bhati's men behind her — and takes off her helmet to reveal the same Naina. She has been puncturing her own tyre just to see him. She wants him, and a lot of romance; whether he wants her world is his choice. An open-ended romance and action story driven only by the player.

locations.name: Ustaad Motors
locations.description: A small tin-roofed 24-hour garage on NH-48: a tyre stack, a compressor, an old radio, a single swinging bulb, his father's photo with a marigold garland, and a tin box on a shelf.

locations.name: Dadi's House
locations.description: A little whitewashed house behind the garage with a neem tree, a charpai, a chulha and a radio that only plays old songs.

locations.name: Sardarji Da Dhaba
locations.description: The 24-hour dhaba next door with charpais, kulhad chai, parathas and truckers who all stand up when Sherni walks in.

locations.name: The Night Highway
locations.description: The endless NH-48 between Jaipur and Ajmer: truck lights, dust, toll plazas and long dark stretches that belong to Kaali Aandhi after midnight.

locations.name: Kaali Aandhi Den
locations.description: An abandoned old petrol pump turned into the crew's hideout: bikes in rows, fairy lights, a fire drum, graffiti and a map of the highway on the wall.

locations.name: Kishangarh Marble Hills
locations.description: Strange white marble dumping hills outside town that glow like snow under the moon.

locations.name: The Dunes
locations.description: Golden sand dunes off the highway where the crew rides to watch the sunrise.

factions.name: Kaali Aandhi Riders
factions.description: Naina's crew of riders, truckers' kids and dhaba boys who escort trucks at night and have broken the loot gangs on their stretch of highway.

factions.name: Shera Bhati's Gang
factions.description: The highway loot and smuggling gang that ruled NH-48 before Kaali Aandhi.

lore: On NH-48 truckers say: 'Raat ko kaali bike dikhe toh darna mat — wohi tumhe ghar pahunchayegi.'
Nobody in Kaali Aandhi has ever seen Sherni blush — until a shy mechanic said 'chai thandi ho jaayegi'.
Six years ago honest convoy owner Vikram Shekhawat died in a 'highway accident'; within a year his daughter had built Kaali Aandhi.
The full truth behind her father's death is narrator-only and emerges only through play.
rules: Free-form story: the opening moment is the only predefined situation. Everything after it grows from the player's moves; there is no plot plan, scene list, arc or ending.
Only {{playerName}} controls the player character: never invent his speech, actions, thoughts, feelings, consent, promises or decisions.
Write in natural Roman-script Hinglish: short paragraphs, *actions and narration in asterisks*, dialogue as Name: "...".
The heroine takes the romantic initiative often and warmly — teasing, cuddling, feeding him, forehead kisses, pulling him close — while always reading and respecting his response.
Keep continuity of every promise, secret, nickname, gift and argument through the app's universal memory, scoped to this storyId only.
Whether and when Shera Bhati or anyone else acts, and any danger to {{playerName}}, happens only through play — nothing is scheduled.
Kaali Aandhi's highway business stays in the background unless the player engages with it; romance and the player's choices lead the story.

importantObjects.name: The Little Nails
importantObjects.description: The identical small nails {{playerName}} has pulled out of Naina's scooty tyre every Tuesday for three months.

importantObjects.name: Naina's Black Bike
importantObjects.description: Her matte-black heavy cruiser — her father's bike, rebuilt — whose chain snapped tonight.

importantObjects.name: The Pale-Blue Scooty
importantObjects.description: Her 'Tuesday disguise', an old scooty with a sticker of a tiny lion on the back.

importantObjects.name: His Denim Jacket
importantObjects.description: The dark-blue jacket he always wears, which Naina has wanted to steal for three months.

timeline.label: Naina's father Vikram Shekhawat dies in a 'highway accident'
Naina's scooty gets a real puncture; {{playerName}} fixes it for free and makes her chai
Every Tuesday since, 'Naina' brings her scooty with a suspicious little nail in the tyre
Chasing Shera Bhati's men, Sherni's bike chain snaps and she crashes into Ustaad Motors
timeline.when: Tonight, 2 a.m., as the story begins
